additional_info.subject: RE: ID0452429-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002653] CU not operational CRM:02888000284
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for the feedback!
I checked the charger remotely via AWS, and indeed the OCPP Backend connection went offline several times during 27.09.2025.
On 29.09.2025 morning, the charger went completely offline also on SCB, therefore I cannot investigate furthermore on the root-cause of the OCPP Backend connection going offline.
An onsite visit is required, to assess the status of the charger, and the connection of router XF3 and XF4.
Please be aware that, on 29.09.2025, before the charger went offline, I saw several error messages:
AC1 : Outlet not ready - PLC has communication error with AC meter
This is a known issue for which a solution is implemented in Hotfix Tia 4.1.22 or in FW v8.0.5. Once the charger is restored, it would be beneficial to update the charger to v8.0.5.
Because an onsite visit is required, I am moving ticket
ID0452429
from the Technical Support to
eMobility RC-IT Si E Queue
.
